items.title: Holiday calculator (statutory copy and rules)
items.source: Spec Section 10.3; UK statutory annual leave (5.6 weeks, 28-day cap); bank holiday counts per UK nation added in v1.3
issues: Verify 5.6 weeks / 28-day cap wording, the pro-rata method and the bank holiday counts (England and Wales 8, Scotland 9, Northern Ireland 10).
Irregular-hours and part-year workers may be calculated differently; the tool's note says so.

items.title: Notice period calculator (statutory copy and rules)
items.source: Spec Section 10.x; UK statutory minimum notice
issues: Verify statutory minimum notice rules and the wording about contractual notice.

items.title: Disclaimer
items.source: Pocket HR App Build Specification v1.0 (MVP)
issues: Flagged by the review panels: 'The app's creators accept no liability for decisions made using this guidance' is blanket liability language that may be misleading or unenforceable. Needs a lawyer's wording; not changed by the build.

items.title: Privacy statement
items.source: Written for SayWotNow; updated v1.4 and v1.5
issues: Check against the actual data handling: preferences and exchange rates only on the device; the currency rates request; nothing typed is stored.

items.title: Search phrases and risky-term messages (content/search.json)
items.source: Written for SayWotNow v1.5 (P1.1) from the guides' keywords and the panels' example queries
issues: New: decides which content appears for everyday phrases. Check that risky terms (harassment, self-harm, dismissal…) always lead to HR-first or urgent help, and that the two safety messages are right.

items.title: Quick Help questions and situation labels (content/quickhelp.json)
items.source: Written for SayWotNow v1.5 (P1.2); the card itself reuses each guide's and prep card's reviewed text
issues: New: plain-language situation labels and the 'Is any of this involved?' options decide whether the HR-first or urgent route is shown. Check none of them can lead a serious case past the HR-first gate.
